cli-quickstart.alt: A terminal recording: orkctl applies each-fan-out, plans it, submits it and watches it to SUCCEEDED, then prints the merge task’s log.
cli-quickstart.caption: orkctl apply, run plan, run submit --watch and run logs, recorded against the local stack: the run finishes with status SUCCEEDED, and the merge task’s log lists the four parts, a to d.

e2e-demo.alt: A screen recording: the each-fan-out example applied from the UI’s Apply page, a run submitted and watched to the end, and its merged artifact opened.
e2e-demo.caption: Apply, submit, watch, open the artifact: one run of examples/each-fan-out.ork.yaml on the local stack.

ui-run-hero.alt: A run of each-fan-out in the OrkStack UI while it runs: the DAG of list, convert and merge, with list done, convert running and merge waiting, beside the run’s version and timing.
ui-run-hero.caption: A real run of examples/each-fan-out.ork.yaml, caught while its fan-out runs.

ui-run-page.alt: The finished run of each-fan-out in the OrkStack UI: list, convert and merge all SUCCEEDED, the leaf task’s values, and the run’s versions, timing and reproduce commands in the aside.
ui-run-page.caption: The same Orkflow’s run, finished.

ui-run-live.alt: The run’s graph in the OrkStack UI while it runs: list done, convert running its items, merge waiting.
ui-run-live.caption: A real run of examples/each-fan-out.ork.yaml, caught while its fan-out runs.

ui-run-finished.alt: The merge task of a finished each-fan-out run, inspected in the run page: SUCCEEDED, its attempt and timing, its log and its artifacts, merged.txt among them.
ui-run-finished.caption: The same Orkflow’s run, finished: a task’s attempts, timing, log and artifacts.

ui-fanout.alt: The convert task’s fan-out in the run page: four items, item 2 opened with its attempt, its timing, its log line and its artifacts.
ui-fanout.caption: Each fan-out item is its own durable activity, with its own attempts and logs.

ui-await.alt: An awaited task in the run page, with the dialog that resolves it: approved checked, the approver filled in, ready to complete.
ui-await.caption: An awaited task waits for a person or a system; resolving it starts the next task.
